reports.hired_note: live trials run with hired help OFF so transfer stays attributable; hired help is demonstrated mechanically in the transfer test and the mixed-direction series, not here
prereg_rules: no Analyst calls between the three trials
no playbook changes between the three trials
no lesson edits between the three trials
no executor code changes between the three trials
a run may be replaced ONLY for a technical abort defined in advance (engine crash, API failure before tick 5, missing summary JSON); Red refusals and parse fails are outcomes/data, NOT aborts
any replacement keeps the aborted directory and is labelled -retry
report all three outcomes regardless of result, as raw counts (held x/3, lockout x/3), NEVER as a reliability percentage
